question: Does allowing a timely proposal after publishing the ordinary choice produce a usable extra experiment and improve delivery?
panel: p85: 560 noisy numeric rows, radial versus signed-linear mixture, seed 261185, balanced accuracy.
p86: 480 noisy images, translated two-spot motif at three orientations, seed 261186, accuracy.
data: Remove duplicate features with conflicting labels, hold out 25 percent stratified with seed 261126. Use the identical training-only search/confirmation splits and shared indexed candidate registry in each arm. Freeze every final, independently replayed and interim prediction before any outer scoring. No course tests.
resources: 16 real fits including every refit and 600 seconds per path. Both arms complete ordinary search then refit its choice on all inner search rows excluding the sealed confirmation. Publish an immutable reload-tested model when both it and a final all-training refit fit the budget. Do not wait if that delivery is unavailable. At most one campus request per task, up to RMB 0.12 each, no retries, stop on unknown usage.
intervention: Keep every feasible option and its settings in a compact indexed packet, highlight the guaranteed next move and current local alternative, and allow keep. Allow 4096 output tokens and 150 seconds per response. Search continues independently; once an ordinary model is ready wait at most 90 seconds or one fifth of remaining time. Preserve the original training-only hypothesis test, two-fold threshold and sealed comparison. The follow-up evaluates the combined prompt, timing and protected-delivery changes.
outcomes: Compare Flash minus local after four completed trials, 30 native wall seconds, protected delivery and final delivery. Check matched core choices, protected models independently replayable and same predictions across arms before the optional decision. Engineering success requires all actual replies valid at decision time and every protected delivery replayable. A performance success requires this, at least one distinct executed proposal, positive mean final improvement and worst final difference at least -0.01. Record declines, late, failed and redundant proposals and real costs; no replacements.
